rows.grounds: ablative compound indicating temporal starting point; sandhyā = twilight, parārdha = later half, kāla = time
locative indicating the portion in which something occurs; pūrva = earlier, ardha = half
verb expressing presence or occurrence under the stated condition

items.question: Under what temporal condition is an occasion situated in the earlier half relative to twilight?
premises: A daily rite may already be in progress.
An occasional rite may arise during that ongoing daily rite.
The timing is measured from the later half of twilight.
items.inference: If the occasion exists in the earlier half from the later half of twilight, that temporal condition applies.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action governed by this condition is carried over from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: If it occurs in the earlier half, counted from the later half of twilight, then that condition holds.
